settings.heading: Materials
settings.content:
Handcrafted from natural wood and hand-painted by skilled artisans. Each piece may have slight variations in wood grain, texture, colour, brushwork, and finish due to its handmade nature. These subtle imperfections are natural characteristics of handcrafted products and make every piece unique.
Every product undergoes a thorough in-house quality check before dispatch to ensure a complete, well-finished and aesthetically pleasing piece reaches you.

settings.heading: Effortless Care
settings.content:
To keep your wooden decor pieces looking their best, dust gently using a soft, dry cloth to wipe away dust and debris.
Keep decor pieces away from direct sunlight, high humidity, and water exposure to prevent damage.

settings.heading: Embracing Wabi-Sabi:
settings.content:
The Beauty of Imperfection
Our sustainable creations celebrate the Japanese philosophy of Wabi-Sabi, finding beauty in imperfection and impermanence. Each piece is crafted with love, embracing the unique character of natural materials and the subtle nuances of handmade production. By valuing the imperfect and the impermanent, we invite you to slow down, appreciate the beauty of simplicity, and live in harmony with nature. Our Wabi-Sabi inspired pieces are not just decor, but a reflection of a mindful and sustainable way of living.
